people.name: Ahaziah
people.line: King of Judah, son of Jehoram and Athaliah

people.name: Joram
people.line: King of N. Israel, son of Ahab

translations.web: Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”
translations.bsb: Joram turned around and fled, calling out to Ahaziah, “Treachery, Ahaziah!”
translations.kjv: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
translations.asv: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
